difficulty_reason: 53 行、BvdB 表示定理的装配式证明：①取 perfect K-单射生成元 K^bullet（bondal-van-den-Bergh 定理），定义 (E,d) = dg 自同态代数；②K-单射性给出 H^n(E) = Ext^n(K,K)，ext 消失引理（本线 L22118）保证只有有限个非零；③K^bullet perfect ⇒ compact，配上 Ext 恒等式后 dga 紧情形引理给全忠实；④右伴随 RHom(K,-) 是左拟逆，tensor-with-QCoh 引理把函子压进 D_QCoh，生成性杀掉伴随核，derived 章形式引理升级为等价。装配逻辑（compact⇒全忠实、伴随拟逆、核零⇒等价）在 span 内逐条给出；9 处引用（4 同章、5 跨章）作导航桩。

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the theorem: the choice of a perfect K-injective generator, the definition of the dg algebra as the dg endomorphism algebra of the generator, the finiteness of its cohomology via vanishing of Ext out of a perfect object, the fully faithfulness of tensoring with the generator via compactness, the right adjoint quasi-inverse, and the vanishing of the adjoint kernel by generation to obtain the equivalence (source lines 4689-4741)
